name: What is a curbless shower conversion and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is a curbless shower conversion and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: A curbless shower conversion removes the raised barrier or curb between the shower stall and the bathroom floor, creating a flat, walk-in entry. This project requires rebuilding the subfloor to create a gentle inward slope toward the drain, ensuring water stays inside the stall without spilling into the main room. Waterproofing is applied across the entire floor and lower walls before tile is installed. Homeowners often choose this setup for modern aesthetics, easier cleaning, and barrier-free accessibility. As a finish contractor, Abraham Becerra coordinates the structural framing adjustments and tile setting so the transition between your main bathroom flooring and shower pan stays completely flush.
acceptedAnswer.description: A curbless shower conversion eliminates the raised threshold, recessing the floor and sloping it toward the drain to create a seamless, barrier-free walk-in shower.
